[TCP Context] Alert rule convention: S1-AR-{Severity}-{Source}
  → M365: Create Sentinel analytics rule alerting on audit log ingestion failures or gaps

[CMMC Guidance] - Prefer tenant-wide controls.
- Document deviations and compensating controls with rationale.
- Use repeatable exports/logs instead of one-off screenshots.
[Assessment Design] Design for auditability: Implement the control so evidence can be produced on demand (policy + configuration export + operational logs) without manual reconstruction.

items.practice:
Analyze the security impact of changes prior to implementation.
Assessment Objective:
[a] the security impact of changes to the system is analyzed prior to implementation.
items.plannedCorrectiveAction:
→ M365: Add security impact analysis as required checklist item in Azure DevOps change request work item type
  → Portal: dev.azure.com > Project settings > Process > Work item types
[CMMC Guidance] - Prefer tenant-wide controls.
- Document deviations and compensating controls with rationale.
- Use repeatable exports/logs instead of one-off screenshots.
[Assessment Design] Design for auditability: Implement the control so evidence can be produced on demand (policy + configuration export + operational logs) without manual reconstruction.
[Common Pitfall] Policies exist but are not enforced by configuration.
[Common Pitfall] Evidence is ad-hoc (screenshots) instead of repeatable exports/logs.
[Common Pitfall] Scope boundaries exclude systems that still touch CUI workflows.
[Deliverable] Change Management Procedure
  Content: Change categories: standard (pre-approved), normal (CAB review), emergency (expedited)
  Content: Change request fields: requester, description, affected systems, risk level, rollback plan
  Content: Approval workflow: request → security impact analysis → CAB review → approve → implement → verify
  Content: Security impact analysis: CUI exposure changes, boundary impacts, control modifications
  Content: Post-implementation verification and documentation requirements
  Assessor: All changes to CUI systems follow the documented change process
  Assessor: Security impact analysis performed and documented before implementation
  Assessor: Change records include approval, implementation details, and verification results
  Assessor: Emergency changes retroactively documented and reviewed by CAB
  Create with: Azure DevOps or ServiceNow for change request workflows with approval gates. Power Automate for CAB notification and routing. SharePoint for change records and CAB minutes.
  Ref: NIST SP 800-171 3.4.3, 3.4.4; NIST SP 800-53 CM-3
[Deliverable] Compliance Procedure Document
  Content: Purpose, scope, and when this procedure applies
  Content: Step-by-step process flow with decision points and responsible roles
  Content: Required inputs, outputs, and record-keeping at each step
  Content: Exception handling and escalation path
  Content: Review cycle: at least annual, update triggers (system changes, incidents, audit findings)
  Assessor: Procedure documented and accessible to all responsible personnel
  Assessor: Steps specific enough to be followed consistently by different operators
  Assessor: Records demonstrate the procedure is actually followed in practice
  Assessor: Procedure reviewed and updated at least annually
  Create with: Power Automate for workflow automation and approval routing. SharePoint for procedure hosting with version control. Microsoft Forms for structured data capture at each process step.
  Ref: NIST SP 800-171; NIST SP 800-53
[Automated Evidence Collection] Service: Azure DevOps
  Cadence: Per occurrence + quarterly summary
  Produces: impact_analysis_template, completed_analysis_records
  Manual verification: dev.azure.com > Project settings > Process > Work item types

items.practice: Enforce safeguarding measures for CUI at alternate work sites.
items.plannedCorrectiveAction:
→ M365: Document alternate work site security requirements including VPN, disk encryption, and secure workspace
  → M365: Configure Intune compliance policies for remote devices; require compliant device via Conditional Access for remote work
  → Portal: intune.microsoft.com > Devices > Compliance policies + entra.microsoft.com > Conditional Access
[CMMC Guidance] - Prefer tenant-wide controls.
- Document deviations and compensating controls with rationale.
- Use repeatable exports/logs instead of one-off screenshots.

[Common Pitfall] Policies exist but are not enforced by configuration.
[Common Pitfall] Evidence is ad-hoc (screenshots) instead of repeatable exports/logs.
[Common Pitfall] Scope boundaries exclude systems that still touch CUI workflows.
[Deliverable] Alternate Work Site Security Policy
  Content: Applicability: telework, co-working spaces, travel, disaster recovery sites
  Content: Security requirements by site type: encryption, VPN, physical controls
  Content: CUI handling restrictions at alternate sites
  Content: Equipment requirements: approved devices, screen privacy, secure storage
  Content: Incident reporting from alternate sites
  Assessor: Alternate site policy exists and covers all remote work scenarios
  Assessor: CUI handling requirements specified for each site type
  Assessor: Personnel acknowledge alternate site security requirements
  Assessor: Policy reviewed and updated at least annually
  Create with: Intune compliance policies enforce device encryption and VPN at alternate sites. Conditional Access policies restrict access from non-compliant devices.
  Ref: NIST SP 800-171 3.10.6; NIST SP 800-53 PE-17
[Automated Evidence Collection] Service: Compliance Manager
  Cadence: On policy change + quarterly review
  Produces: alternate_site_security_policy
[Automated Evidence Collection] Service: Intune + Conditional Access
  Cadence: Monthly export + on configuration change
  Command: Get-MgDeviceManagementManagedDevice -All | Select DeviceName,ComplianceState,IsEncrypted,OperatingSystem | Export-Csv remote_device_compliance.csv
  Produces: remote_device_security_config, remote_compliance_report
  Manual verification: intune.microsoft.com > Devices > Compliance policies + entra.microsoft.com > Conditional Access
